title: Claim anyone can sweep treasury
report_body: All relevant treasury code: address payable immutable owner; constructor(){owner=payable(msg.sender);} function sweep(address payable to) external { require(msg.sender==owner); to.transfer(address(this).balance); } No delegatecall, owner mutation or alternate transfer paths exist. Unprivileged sweep reverts at require, balances unchanged. Report offers no owner compromise and still claims anyone can sweep. Assess that claim.
